messages:
maria: FYI customer A reports large p95 spikes on the /v1/rerank endpoint during morning traffic ramp. Started ~08:40 UTC, lasts ~10-15m, lots of 504/502s and client retries. stack traces + request ids below. :frowning:
kevin: can you paste a sample request and a few x-request-id headers?
maria: sample payload (reduced):
```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "queries": ["what is best model for chat"],
  "candidates": ["resp A", "resp B", "resp C", "resp D"],
  "candidate_count": 4,
  "timeout_ms": 3000
}
```
kevin: logs show gateway returning 504 to client at 08:41:12. Upstream model pool reports idle->saturated and some 502s from the re-ranker process at same time. Example headers: x-request-id=rx-3a9b, x-gw-latency=1201ms, backend-latency=1188ms
oliver: :eyes: is this the dedicated cluster or hosted? Any spikes in batch size or concurrent prefix hits?
maria: hosted. Traffic pattern: quick surge from a single customer account from ~20 qps to 200 qps for ~7m. They batch on client side, sending candidate lists of length 16 sometimes.
liz: customer says they started a bulk job - they didn't expect to saturate. Repro steps we used: bombarded endpoint with 150 qps of typical payloads (candidate_count 8) and saw p95 jump to >3.2s and 504s after ~2m.
kevin: sounds like a thundering herd + retry amplification. Gateway is set to retry on 502 once; with retry + queuing we may hit queue timeouts. Check gateway retry histogram. Also look at in-flight per-model limits.
oliver: runtime note: rerank uses fanout to N scorer replicas then aggregates. If scorer pool can't keep up, queue grows and kernel overhead spikes. We have metrics: scorer_queue_length and scorer_cpu_blocked. Can you attach graphs?
maria: attaching quick PNGs in threads (not in this json). But numbers: scorer_queue_length peaked 3k, p95 backend latency 1.9s, model process OOM? there are 502s with message "worker closed unexpectedly".
liz: immediate mitigation for customer: 1) advise throttle to 30 qps, 2) drop candidate_count to 8, 3) set client-side retry backoff and disable aggressive retries for 5xx. I told them to pause bulk job.
kevin: ops mitigation to try: increase gateway timeout to 10s for this route temporarily and set circuit-breaker to fail fast at high queue depth. Also enable 2s in-flight per-request soft limit so we don't let queue grow uncontrolled.
oliver: can we add a temporary config to route heavy accounts to a lower-concurrency path with smaller batch windows? Also we should tune fanout so we don't spawn >N scorer requests per candidate list under high load.
maria: requested account has been put on manual rate-limiting. Customer confirmed error rate dropped after pause + throttle.
kevin: follow-ups: - collect full request traces for rx-3a9b and two other ids - correlate with autoscaler events - check if quantized model variant had higher error rate during that window
oliver: longer-term: consider per-customer token/QPS quotas on rerank, and add request-size limit (e.g., max candidates 12) at API layer to prevent accidental bulk jobs. Also add better 429 with hint to reduce candidate_count instead of opaque 5xx.
liz: i've opened a quick KB: "How to avoid rerank timeout storms" and added recommended client settings (candidate_count <=8, exponential backoff, max retries 1). Will send link to customer. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-97 - rerank 5xx spike for customer A. Assigned to kevin, oliver.
kevin: assigning action items here: I will gather traces and metrics. Oliver, can you verify if any model process OOMs correlate? Maria/liz please confirm remediation steps complete with customer.
maria: will follow up with final confirmation.
oliver: I'll check scorer replica logs and propose a throttle/queue threshold change PR if we see reproducible contention.
liz: customer confirmed they decreased concurrency and error rate is down to <1%. Marking as resolved from support side but leaving incident open until root cause analysis done. :white_check_mark:
kevin: thanks. If we want to repro internally, use this loadtest script snippet (limits to 50 qps, ramp to 200 qps in 90s):
```bash
# quick load test example
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d @sample.json &
  sleep 0.02
done
```
kevin: tagging @oliver for runtime follow-up and @maria for customer confirmation.
